newsitem.title: USA: Mizar to buy back up to $1 mln of shrs.
newsitem.headline: Mizar to buy back up to $1 mln of shrs.

text.p: Mizar Inc said Thursday that its board of directors has authorized it to repurchase up to $1 million worth of its outstanding common stock between now and May 27, 1998.
Repurchases, said the company, can be made from time to time in the open market, as well as through privately negotiated transactions, at the discretion of management.
The company said it will use the stock for employee stock plans as well as for general corporate purposes.
Mizar is a supplier of computing products for the real-time signal ad image processing market.
